high_level_description: This image captures a scene at an ancient temple complex during a rainy day. The setting is characterized by heavy rainfall, with water pooling on the ground and cascading down the stone structures. The architecture of the temple is intricate, featuring large stone pillars and detailed carvings, including prominent lion statues flanking the entrance. In the foreground, there are several people walking through the rain. One person is holding a blue umbrella, while another is holding a black umbrella. They appear to be tourists or visitors exploring the site despite the weather.
